commands.command: Design and test a proof-surface retention repair that preserves fresh rollout margin gaps instead of only improving fixed snippet logprob loss.
commands.name: m132_rollout_margin_retention_repair

decision_rule: Only admit a repair if it improves or preserves fresh strict outcome-surface diversity while retaining M124 behavior and keeping M62 controls clean.
failure_criteria: fixed-corpus loss improves but fresh rollout margin gaps shrink
selected physical pairs remain below prior proof-surface thresholds
the source-side perturbed-only limitation is hidden
hypothesis: M131 shows M129 increases one-step action separation but shrinks fresh rollout margin gaps. A rollout-margin retention repair should preserve the outcome proof surface better than the fixed logprob-only objective.
success_criteria: fresh visible wrong-history margin gaps do not shrink relative to M124
selected physical pairs and selected seeds recover relative to M129
behavior retention remains at M124 level
PPO readiness is decided by the formal gate after the repair
